title: MCV–RDW interaction does not reliably improve fasting-glucose-based HbA1c prediction across independent NHANES samples
abstract: Adding a prespecified MCV–RDW interaction to fasting glucose, nonlinear separate CBC indices and standard covariates changed held-cycle weighted HbA1c MSE by 0.00036420 percentage-point² (baseline minus augmented; 95% paired source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00069399 to 0.00114277); improvement was not reliable and reversed with cubic CBC adjustment.
